query: How many days of annual leave does an employee with 4 years of service get?
ground_truth: 16 days (3 to under 5 years of service)

query: Can annual leave be taken as half-day or quarter-day leave? How many hours is each?
ground_truth: Yes. Half-day leave is 4 hours and quarter-day leave is 2 hours.

query: By when and where do I request annual leave?
ground_truth: Submit the request in the groupware 'Attendance' menu at least 1 business day before the planned date; the Team Lead approves it. In urgent cases, it can be registered after the fact by 10 a.m. on the day itself.

query: What is the maximum number of annual leave days?
ground_truth: 25 days (21 or more years of service)

query: How many days is spouse's childbirth leave, and by when can it be used?
ground_truth: 20 paid days; it may be split and used within 120 days of the birth date.

query: How many days per week is remote work allowed, and is separate approval required?
ground_truth: Up to 2 days per week. Register it in the groupware 'Attendance' menu by the previous day; separate approval from the Team Lead is not required.

query: What is the per-person meal limit for dinner?
ground_truth: KRW 30,000 (VAT included)

query: Can alcohol be reimbursed at a team dinner?
ground_truth: As a rule it is not reimbursable; it is recognized only when an entertainment expense pre-approval request has been approved.

query: Who approves an expense of more than KRW 300,000 and up to KRW 1,000,000?
ground_truth: Division Head

query: Up to what amount are simplified receipts accepted, and by when must the expense report be submitted?
ground_truth: Only amounts of KRW 30,000 or less are accepted, and the expense report must be submitted within 7 days of the expense date.

query: What is the lodging cap per night in Seoul for a domestic business trip?
ground_truth: KRW 150,000 per night

query: Can I put an Excel file containing customer contact details into a generative AI tool?
ground_truth: Customer personal information must not be entered. If it is absolutely necessary, mask or de-identify it first and use it only in the company-approved service (Contoso AI).

query: If a personal information leak is suspected, when and to whom do I report it?
ground_truth: Report it to the Information Security Team (ext. 7777) within 1 hour and submit an incident report within 24 hours.

query: How often should the HEPA filter of the AirPure AP-500 be replaced?
ground_truth: Every 12 months (the pre-filter is washed with water every 6 months)

query: What is the battery warranty period of the RoboClean R7, and what are the criteria for a free replacement?
ground_truth: The battery warranty is 1 year. If the battery capacity drops below 70% of its capacity at the time of purchase, the battery is replaced free of charge within the warranty period.

query: Within how many days can a defective product be exchanged or refunded?
ground_truth: Within 30 days of purchase, it is exchanged for a new one or refunded (for a simple change of mind: within 7 days, only if unused and unopened).

query: What are the liquidated damages rate and cap for late delivery?
ground_truth: 0.1% of the contract amount per day of delay, capped at 10% of the contract amount

query: At what contract value is Legal Team review required?
ground_truth: KRW 50 million or more (at KRW 500 million or more, CFO approval is also required)

query: What purchasing method applies to purchases of KRW 50 million or more?
ground_truth: Electronic competitive bidding

query: What happens if a supplier receives a C grade twice in a row?
ground_truth: Suspension of business dealings with the supplier is considered.

query: How much is our company's parking subsidy for employees?
ground_truth: This is not stated in the provided policies, so it cannot be answered; ask the responsible department.

query: What is Contoso's operating profit this year?
ground_truth: This is not stated in the provided policies, so it cannot be answered.
